description: This file defines the NotesService class in an Angular frontend application, providing CRUD operations for notes via REST API endpoints. It includes methods for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, archiving, and pinning notes, utilizing Angular's HttpClient. The class is decorated with @Injectable and uses environment variables for configuration.

classes.name: NotesService
classes.description: A service class in Angular for managing notes via REST API, including CRUD operations, archiving, and pinning functionalities.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches a list of notes with optional filtering parameters such as query, tag, archived status, and pinned status.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its unique identifier.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note with provided data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by its ID with new data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note identified by its ID.

methods.name: archive
methods.description: Marks a note as archived or unarchived.
